question: What does continuity of midwifery care actually mean? Please explain in plain words.
review: Explain the concept directly in everyday words, with a relevant citation; no catalogue of studies or birth-plan recommendation.

sources.title: CG190 Intrapartum care for healthy women and babies: Full guideline Addendum 190.2

text: Continuity of midwifery care means the same midwife, or a small known team, looks after you through pregnancy, birth and after the baby is born, instead of you meeting lots of different people [1][2][3].
